prompt: a photo of a door in an interior wall, with a door leaf, frame and handle
notes: Any door: interior or exterior, open or closed. ADE20K-150 label 14 ('door;double;door'), matched on its first synonym. Split into door_open/door_closed later by adding rows -- but note ADE has no such distinction, so both rows would need the same 'ade' value, which ade_to_class rejects. Doors are the one class stage 1B measures against the LiDAR before discarding.

prompt: a photo of a window in a building wall, with glass panes and a window frame
notes: Any glazed opening: window, window bay, glazed door panel, shutter-covered window. ADE20K-150 label 8 ('windowpane;window'). Note ADE segments the glazed BAY, so the mask routinely includes a radiator or mullion standing in front of the glass -- which is what the downstream polygon fit wants (it fits the frame, not the glass) but is not what the class name says.

prompt: a photo of a plain wall, floor, ceiling, radiator or piece of furniture
notes: Everything that is not an opening. The 'ade' column is deliberately EMPTY: every one of the other 148 ADE classes falls in here by omission, so 'other' is a real catch-all rather than a single prompt straining to cover walls, floors, radiators, pillars, people and clutter. Adding more 'other' rows is still NOT supported: class names must be unique in this file.
